settings.heading: How do I know if it's real copper?
settings.content:
Real copper is not magnetic. A lot of “copper” jewellery online is only a thin copper coating over cheaper metal, or mixed with iron or nickel – and that kind of piece will usually stick to a magnet.

Try it yourself the day your piece arrives:

  • Take any fridge magnet
  • Hold it against your bracelet, ring or anklet
  • If it sticks – even slightly – it isn't solid copper

Not happy with the result? You're covered by our 30-day return guarantee. Questions about a specific piece? Email support@shopsterlingco.com.

settings.question: I've tried copper jewellery before and it didn't last. Why is this different?
settings.answer: Most cheap “copper” jewellery is only plated or mixed with other metals, so the colour wears off fast. The Copper Edit pieces are solid copper – the colour you see goes all the way through. Do the magnet test the day it arrives.

settings.question: Does copper actually do anything, or is it just a trend?
settings.answer: Copper has been worn for over 3,000 years, and today it's especially loved by women who want a piece that feels meaningful, not just decorative. Many customers tell us it simply became part of their morning routine. We sell copper as jewellery – we don't make medical claims. If you have a health concern, please speak to your doctor.

settings.question: Will copper turn my skin green?
settings.answer: It can leave a harmless green tint on some skin – that's a natural reaction between real copper, skin and moisture, and it washes off with soap. A thin layer of clear nail polish on the inside of the piece prevents it.

settings.question: Can I wear it in the shower or the ocean?
settings.answer:
• Washing your hands is fine
  • We recommend taking it off for swimming, especially in chlorine or salt water
  • Moisture speeds up the natural patina
  • Dry it after contact with water and store it dry

settings.question: How do I clean my copper?
settings.answer: Love the patina? Do nothing. Want the shine back? Rub it with a soft cloth and a little lemon juice and salt (or ketchup), rinse and dry.

settings.question: Will it fit my wrist?
settings.answer: Most Copper Edit bracelets have an open, adjustable design. Gently squeeze or open it a little to fit your wrist – slowly, a little at a time.
